p.src: 1  Judge me, LORD, for I have walked in my integrity. I have trusted also in the LORD without wavering.

en: Judge me, LORD, for I have walked in my integrity. I have trusted also in the LORD without wavering.
u.src: 1  Judge me, LORD, for I have walked in my integrity. I have trusted also in the LORD without wavering.

p.src: 2  Examine me, LORD, and prove me. Try my heart and my mind.

en: Examine me, LORD, and prove me. Try my heart and my mind.
u.src: 2  Examine me, LORD, and prove me. Try my heart and my mind.

p.src: 3  For your loving kindness is before my eyes. I have walked in your truth.

en: For your loving kindness is before my eyes. I have walked in your truth.
u.src: 3  For your loving kindness is before my eyes. I have walked in your truth.

p.src: 4  I have not sat with deceitful men, neither will I go in with hypocrites.

en: I have not sat with deceitful men, neither will I go in with hypocrites.
u.src: 4  I have not sat with deceitful men, neither will I go in with hypocrites.

p.src: 5  I hate the assembly of evildoers, and will not sit with the wicked.

en: I hate the assembly of evildoers, and will not sit with the wicked.
u.src: 5  I hate the assembly of evildoers, and will not sit with the wicked.

p.src: 6  I will wash my hands in innocence, so I will go about your altar, LORD,

en: I will wash my hands in innocence, so I will go about your altar, LORD,
u.src: 6  I will wash my hands in innocence, so I will go about your altar, LORD,

p.src: 7  that I may make the voice of thanksgiving to be heard and tell of all your wondrous deeds.

en: that I may make the voice of thanksgiving to be heard and tell of all your wondrous deeds.
u.src: 7  that I may make the voice of thanksgiving to be heard and tell of all your wondrous deeds.

p.src: 8  LORD, I love the habitation of your house, the place where your glory dwells.

en: LORD, I love the habitation of your house, the place where your glory dwells.
u.src: 8  LORD, I love the habitation of your house, the place where your glory dwells.

p.src: 9  Don’t gather my soul with sinners, nor my life with bloodthirsty men

en: Don’t gather my soul with sinners, nor my life with bloodthirsty men
u.src: 9  Don’t gather my soul with sinners, nor my life with bloodthirsty men

p.src: 10  in whose hands is wickedness; their right hand is full of bribes.

en: in whose hands is wickedness; their right hand is full of bribes.
u.src: 10  in whose hands is wickedness; their right hand is full of bribes.

p.src: 11  But as for me, I will walk in my integrity. Redeem me, and be merciful to me.

en: But as for me, I will walk in my integrity. Redeem me, and be merciful to me.
u.src: 11  But as for me, I will walk in my integrity. Redeem me, and be merciful to me.

p.src: 12  My foot stands in an even place. In the congregations I will bless the LORD.

en: My foot stands in an even place. In the congregations I will bless the LORD.
u.src: 12  My foot stands in an even place. In the congregations I will bless the LORD.
